name: The Bend
note: Motor racing circuit and venue at Tailem Bend, South Australia (named Shell V-Power Motorsport Park under a 2023 naming-rights deal), owned by the Shahin family's Peregrine Corporation (claim peregrine-corporation-the-bend-owner). Major sponsor carried in the name of the The Bend Manthey #92 Porsche 911 GT3 R entry in the 2026 FIA WEC LMGT3 class (Manthey's season announcement). Private family company; nothing else found. Proposed tier: none (see PR).
